name: Central
beschreibung:
Hotel Central welcomes guests in the vibrant heart of St. Johann in Tirol with authentic alpine charm and contemporary living comfort. Its thoughtfully appointed rooms provide a relaxing haven after an adventurous day outdoors.

Thanks to its central location, mountain cable cars, town amenities, and scenic hiking or cycling trails are just moments away. In winter, groomed ski pistes and cross-country tracks offer direct alpine access.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Central in St. Johann in Tirol offers top comfort and a central setting for active travellers exploring the Kitzbuehel Alps.
